The most serious: C2 keys off a follow-up 'mostly there' message that never appears in the conversation; C22 requires a specific home-care regimen (hydrocortisone, cetirizine, cool compresses, with exact start dates) the user never mentions; and C26 and C29 invent an exact 'word count: NNN (cap: 250)' line and a 250-word limit the prompt never sets (it only says 'keep it tight'). On top of that, a cluster of checks (C17-C25) dictate exact wording, formats, and labels for parts of the message the prompt left open, and C13 ranks poison oak as the top differential with no supporting evidence.
